filing_cutoff: Coinbase Q3 2026 Form 10-Q filed 2026-10-29; Circle Q2 2026 Form 10-Q is the latest Circle filing available in this capture.

operating_metrics.average_usdc_held_in_coinbase_products: All-time high, company-reported; not identical to quarter-end AOP.

coinbase_q3_2026.accounting_caveat: During Q1 2026 Coinbase reclassified revenue earned on corporate payment-stablecoin balances from stablecoin revenue to other revenue. Prior periods were reclassified. Stablecoin revenue and corporate interest/other income must not be conflated.

circle_q2_2026.collaboration_terms: Coinbase allocations depend on USDC held on its platform after issuer retention and a share of broader ecosystem growth after approved third-party participant amounts.
circle_q2_2026.reserve_income_sensitivity: Circle attributed approximately $147.4M of Q2 reserve-income growth to higher average daily USDC circulation and expanded partnerships, offset by approximately $113.9M from a 66bp lower average reserve yield.

metric_reconciliation.circle_usdc_on_platform_definition: Includes Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and non-custodial wallets offered through Circle's platform, including managed wallet services.
metric_reconciliation.coinbase_usdc_aop_definition: Coinbase AOP includes customer assets held or managed in its digital wallets and custody services, but excludes assets for which the customer holds full or partial keys.
metric_reconciliation.conclusion: Circle's $12.442B Q2 USDC-on-platform metric and Coinbase's $8.616B Q3 USDC AOP are not directly comparable. They have different dates and scope. Do not infer a $3.826B outflow, decline or reconciliation gap.
metric_reconciliation.average_vs_end_of_period: Coinbase's all-time-high average USDC held in products can coexist with a lower quarter-end AOP because the measures differ in time aggregation and asset scope.

strategic_assessment.confirmed: Coinbase is diversifying revenue across stablecoins, derivatives, custody, onchain trading and lending while spot activity weakened. Circle remains a strategically material USDC distribution partner.
strategic_assessment.inference: Coinbase's stablecoin earnings are exposed to both USDC balance growth and reserve-rate compression; increased balances did not fully offset lower rates in Q3.
strategic_assessment.counter_hypothesis: Derivative growth, expanded product mix and onchain lending may offset spot weakness over time, but Q3 data do not establish that this offset is durable.
strategic_assessment.disconfirming: Q3 stablecoin revenue fell 5% year over year and nine-month stablecoin revenue was essentially flat despite higher average USDC balances; lower rates materially offset balance growth.

next_actions: Ingest Circle Q3 2026 Form 10-Q when filed and reconcile distribution costs, Coinbase platform balances and reserve return rate.
Capture Coinbase's daily/quarterly USDC balance measures separately from Circle's platform measure.
Separate Circle-derived Coinbase revenue, interest income on corporate stablecoin balances, and customer rewards/expenses in the revenue model.
